channel.title: Surfaced — Discover What's Next
channel.description: Fresh discoveries, trending products, hidden gems, future tech, and daily tools — curated every day.

item.title: beacon.sh
item.description: beacon.sh provides an open-source, self-improving memory layer for AI coding agents. It integrates with over 20 different agent harnesses, including popular ones like Claude Code and Cursor. By capturing and compounding knowledge from every agent session, beacon.sh ensures that each subsequent agent interaction starts with a richer, more informed context. This eliminates redundant learning and allows AI agents to become progressively smarter and more efficient over time. The project is licensed under MIT and is actively developed on GitHub.

item.title: Alsona
item.description: Alsona is an AI-powered sales intelligence tool that identifies prospects showing immediate buying intent. It analyzes over 32 diverse signals, including hiring trends, funding announcements, technology adoption, customer reviews, and ad spend, to pinpoint individuals and companies most likely to purchase. The platform then translates these signals into personalized outreach strategies, aiming to convert passive interest into booked sales calls. Pricing is typically offered via custom quotes, reflecting its enterprise-grade capabilities.

item.title: HGhub
item.description: HGhub is a universal video player that connects to content through plugins. It consolidates browsing, searching, playback, and personal media libraries into a single application. By importing JavaScript plugins, users can access diverse content sources and manage them through a unified interface. HGhub itself does not provide content sources or distribute third-party plugins, placing the control and responsibility with the user. It supports HLS and standard video formats, offering flexible playback options like line switching and resolution adjustments.

item.title: kiri
item.description: Kiri is a lightweight and high-performance container runtime designed for macOS, Windows, and Linux. It's built to be a direct replacement for Docker, allowing you to run your existing Docker images seamlessly. Kiri works with the Docker CLI, Compose, and buildx that you already use, ensuring a smooth transition. It also offers a free alternative to services like Ngrok for exposing local services to the internet. Its primary focus is on speed and minimal resource consumption, making it ideal for development environments.

item.title: rea-video
item.description: rea-video is a revolutionary tool designed for reverse-engineering video content, allowing users to break down any video—whether filmed, AI-generated, or coded—shot by shot. It details the creation process and provides insights on how to remake it. The analyses are documented in the open VIDEO.md format, making the breakdowns accessible and interpretable. This tool is invaluable for understanding video production techniques, identifying AI influences, and learning how to replicate complex visual effects.

item.title: misterdownloadmanager
item.description: misterdownloadmanager is a powerful, open-source download manager built from the ground up in Rust, offering a clean and efficient alternative to traditional download tools. It focuses on speed and reliability, claiming to be faster than established download managers like Internet Download Manager (IDM). The tool supports Windows, macOS, and Linux, ensuring broad compatibility. A key feature is its browser extension, simplifying the process of capturing and managing downloads directly from your web browser.

item.title: /dev/null
item.description: /dev/null is a social network specifically built for web developers, conceived and constructed from scratch in a 48-hour live stream event. It aims to foster a community where developers can connect, share knowledge, and discuss topics relevant to their craft. The platform emphasizes open communication and collaboration, mirroring the spirit of open-source development. While the core concept originated from a live coding session, its evolution suggests a platform dedicated to the practical needs and shared experiences of software engineers.

item.title: Lichii
item.description: Lichii is a highly experimental emulator designed to run Nintendo Switch 2 games on PC. Developed with C++, it aims to replicate the hardware and software environment of the next-generation Switch console. As a bleeding-edge project, it's primarily intended for developers and enthusiasts testing compatibility and performance. The project offers no official support beyond its GitHub repository and a game compatibility website, emphasizing that downloads should only come from its official release pages to avoid malware.

item.title: Inner Balance
item.description: Inner Balance is a biofeedback device and app designed to help users improve their heart rate variability (HRV). By using a small sensor that attaches to your earlobe and connects to your smartphone or tablet, the app provides real-time feedback on your HRV, guiding you through breathing exercises to promote a state of coherence. This practice is known to reduce stress and enhance emotional regulation. The core functionality is free with optional premium features for deeper analysis and guided programs.

item.title: learnharness
item.description: LearnHarness is an open-source AI agent harness engineered to streamline the learning of complex subjects. It constructs personalized learning roadmaps by assessing a user's existing knowledge base and articulating their specific learning objectives. The system then orchestrates a sequence of lessons and practical exercises, dynamically adjusting the learning path in response to the user's ongoing progress. This adaptive methodology is especially effective for dissecting intricate topics into more digestible components.

item.title: Quoteblaze
item.description: Quoteblaze is an AI-powered tool designed to help writers generate compelling quotes and impactful text snippets. It analyzes your input and can suggest variations, rephrasings, and entirely new quotes that capture a specific tone or message. This freemium tool is particularly useful for content creators, marketers, and anyone looking to enhance their writing with memorable phrases. It excels at quickly producing multiple quote options for social media posts, blog intros, or even creative writing.

item.title: openidea
item.description: OpenIDEA is a native desktop IDE built in Rust, aiming to replicate the familiar IntelliJ IDEA workflow for developers. It offers an IntelliJ IDEA-style keymap, tool windows, and the powerful 'search everywhere' functionality, all within a fast, native application. Beyond the editor, it includes code insight, a debugger, Git integration, a terminal, and database and HTTP clients, supporting over 60 languages. It's a free and open-source project focused on delivering a premium IDE experience with excellent performance.

item.title: unslop
item.description: unslop is a specialized Claude Code and Codex skill designed to transform AI-generated, often messy 'vibecoded' user interfaces into polished, designed interfaces. It intelligently identifies and removes common AI UI 'slop'—like excessive gradients, glows, emoji clutter, and inconsistent spacing—and applies design principles to create a cohesive look. This tool is free. Its strength lies in its ability to interpret your product's intent and meticulously refine UI elements, pass by pass, much like a human designer.

item.title: dsh-Go
item.description: dsh-Go is an Android client for DeepSeek Harness, allowing you to run and control your computer's DeepSeek Harness instance directly from your mobile device. It provides a convenient way to manage your computational tasks remotely. This tool is free to use. It excels at offering on-the-go access to your powerful computing resources without needing to be physically at your desk.

item.title: HyperAud.io
item.description: HyperAud.io is a powerful analytics platform specifically designed for podcasters, offering deep insights into listener behavior and content performance. It provides detailed data on downloads, listener demographics, episode popularity, and audience retention, all presented through an intuitive dashboard. The platform operates on a freemium model, offering a robust free tier for basic analytics and paid plans for advanced features and larger podcasts. It excels at pinpointing exactly where listeners drop off within an episode, a crucial metric for improving content engagement.

item.title: Couchers.org
item.description: Couchers.org is a new, open-source social network designed to give users more control over their data and online interactions. It operates on a federated model, meaning no single entity owns or controls the entire network, fostering a more resilient and privacy-focused experience. The platform is free to use, with development supported by donations and volunteer contributions, aiming to provide a sustainable alternative to commercial social media giants. A key feature is its emphasis on granular privacy controls, allowing users to precisely dictate who sees their content.

item.title: DeepSeek SuperAgent Prototype
item.description: The DeepSeek SuperAgent Prototype is a research project exploring the development of more autonomous agent systems, primarily built using TypeScript. It's not intended for production use and should be treated as experimental code, potentially containing bugs and inconsistent engineering practices. The core value lies in its demonstration of agent-based development, where coding agents contribute to the engineering process. It's a free, open-source initiative from DeepSeek-AI aimed at advancing research in AI agent capabilities and is particularly relevant for developers and researchers interested in the cutting edge of AI-driven software development.

item.title: Aerial TV
item.description: Aerial TV is an open-source, ad-free launcher for Android TV devices, inspired by the clean interface of tvOS. It replaces cluttered manufacturer home screens with a minimalist display of your apps, wallpapers, and captivating aerial screen savers. The launcher is designed for devices like Xiaomi, TCL, and other Chinese market TVs, but works on most Android TV boxes and projectors. It's free and open-source, offering a streamlined user experience without intrusive recommendations or advertisements. It excels at creating a visually pleasing and distraction-free media center environment.

item.title: Obsidian
item.description: Obsidian is a powerful, local-first knowledge base and note-taking app that uses Markdown files. It excels at creating interconnected notes through bi-directional linking, allowing you to build a personal wiki or a second brain. The core app is free for personal use, with paid options for commercial use and advanced sync/publish features. It's particularly adept at surfacing relationships between disparate ideas, a feat few other Markdown editors manage with such elegance.

item.title: nxnative
item.description: nxnative enables you to run Nintendo Switch games natively on your iPhone, iPad, and Mac. By converting your game's NSP files and prod.keys into an IPA, it allows the game's original code to execute directly on Apple silicon. This isn't an emulator; it rebuilds Switch graphics using Metal, offering a direct experience. The project is free and open-source, with community Mac apps available to simplify the conversion process without needing command-line knowledge.

item.title: Sigil
item.description: Sigil is a free and open-source ebook editor that allows you to create and edit EPUB files directly, without the need for complex markup. It provides a WYSIWYG (What You See Is What You Get) interface alongside a code editor, making it accessible for both novice and experienced ebook creators. This tool is invaluable for authors and publishers who want fine-grained control over their ebook formatting, allowing for precise adjustments to layout, metadata, and content that automated conversion tools often miss. It excels at producing clean, standards-compliant EPUBs.

item.title: Pancake
item.description: Pancake positions itself as the 'Vercel for Go-To-Market' (GTM), providing developers and marketers with the essential building blocks to deploy any GTM strategy powered by AI agents like Claude or Codex. It offers a 'GTM Brain' for strategic decision-making, robust sending infrastructure, and integrations with over 40 data sources. Pancake is a freemium product, with core functionalities available to get started quickly. It streamlines the process of launching and managing AI-driven growth initiatives.

item.title: DeepInfer
item.description: DeepInfer is a cutting-edge, high-performance inference framework specifically designed for large-scale deployment of DeepSeek models. It is built in Python and optimized to maximize throughput and minimize latency for complex deep learning workloads. The framework is open-source and free to use, offering advanced features for efficient model execution in production environments. It excels at handling batched inference requests with optimal resource utilization.

item.title: gpu-unlock
item.description: gpu-unlock is a C-based utility designed to significantly boost the AI performance of select NVIDIA GeForce graphics cards, specifically targeting the 20, 30, and 40 series. It addresses a common limitation where these GPUs operate at half speed for AI tasks, unlocking up to 2x the FP16, BF16, and TF32 tensor throughput. This tool is essential for individuals and professionals working with demanding AI workloads, machine learning models, and deep learning applications who want to maximize their hardware's potential without purchasing more expensive professional-grade GPUs.

item.title: cleanyourtv
item.description: Cleanyourtv is a Python-based utility designed to debloat any Android or Google TV, transforming its user interface to resemble the cleaner, more streamlined experience of an Apple TV. It operates over Wi-Fi, allowing for remote management and cleanup of pre-installed bloatware and unnecessary applications that often clutter smart TV operating systems. This tool is particularly useful for users who find their TV's default interface slow or filled with unwanted apps and advertisements, offering a way to reclaim performance and simplify navigation.

item.title: Spira Maxima
item.description: Spira Maxima is an innovative AI-powered tool that transforms written scripts into complete, ready-to-post social media videos. It automates the entire production process, from selecting an AI presenter and sourcing on-trend B-roll footage to adding captions and background music, all in a single pass. The platform even allows for the creation of an AI clone of your photo and voice for a personalized touch. This service streamlines video creation for social media marketing, offering a fast and efficient way to generate engaging content.

item.title: Filee
item.description: Filee is a free, open-source desktop application that allows users to convert files across a remarkable 263 different formats, all offline. Simply drag and drop your files into the intuitive interface to convert images, PDFs, Office documents (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), HWP/HWPX, videos, audio, e-books, and archives. It's designed for privacy and speed, as no files are uploaded to the cloud, and it doesn't require any additional software like Microsoft Office to perform conversions. This makes it an incredibly versatile and secure solution for everyday file management needs.

item.title: anatomy
item.description: Anatomy is a powerful JavaScript-based agent skill designed for creating detailed, interactive isometric illustrations of complex real-world machines and systems. It generates polished Scalable Vector Graphics (SVGs) that can be further enhanced with optional WebGL shaders and 3D effects for a dynamic visual experience. This tool is particularly adept at visualizing intricate mechanical processes and technical diagrams with a high degree of accuracy and aesthetic appeal. It's free and open-source, making advanced visualization accessible to a wide range of users.

item.title: Sidenotes
item.description: Sidenotes is a compact and accessible note-taking application that allows users to capture fleeting thoughts and information instantly. It lives as a small, always-on window or a global hotkey away, preventing the need to switch contexts to a full-fledged note-taking suite. This tool is completely free, making it an easily adoptable addition to any digital workflow. Its primary advantage is its pervasive availability, ensuring that no idea or piece of information is lost due to the inconvenience of opening a larger application.

item.title: Resty
item.description: Resty is a straightforward and intuitive HTTP client application designed for developers to test and interact with web services and APIs. It provides a clean interface for crafting requests, inspecting responses, and managing collections of API endpoints. The tool is entirely free and open-source, making it an accessible choice for individuals and teams. Its strength lies in its no-frills approach, offering essential functionalities without the complexity of larger, more feature-rich API clients.

item.title: Typeshare
item.description: Typeshare is a dedicated platform for writing and publishing social media content, particularly long-form posts for platforms like Twitter (X) and LinkedIn. It provides a distraction-free writing environment with features like a word count, readability score, and the ability to preview how your post will look. Typeshare helps users craft engaging threads and articles, streamlining the process of sharing insights and building an audience online. It's a freemium service, with advanced analytics and team features available in paid plans.

item.title: Notion
item.description: Notion is a highly flexible, all-in-one workspace that combines note-taking, task management, databases, and project collaboration into a single application. You can build custom workflows, organize information with pages and sub-pages, and use various blocks like checklists, tables, Kanban boards, and calendars. Notion operates on a freemium model, offering extensive capabilities for individuals and small teams, with paid tiers unlocking more features for larger organizations. It excels at creating interconnected systems for managing diverse information.

item.title: Grammarly
item.description: Grammarly is an AI-powered writing assistant that goes beyond simple spell check and grammar correction. It analyzes your text for clarity, conciseness, tone, and style, offering suggestions to improve your overall communication. It operates across various platforms, from web browsers and desktop apps to mobile keyboards, ensuring your writing is polished wherever you are. Grammarly offers a freemium model, with advanced features like plagiarism detection and fluency suggestions available in its premium version.

item.title: Tailscale
item.description: Tailscale is a zero-configuration VPN that creates a secure, private network for your devices, regardless of their location. It uses WireGuard to create an encrypted mesh network, making it incredibly easy to connect to your home servers, development environments, or cloud instances securely. Tailscale offers a generous free tier for personal use and paid plans for businesses. It excels at providing seamless, secure connectivity without complex network configuration.

item.title: Warp
item.description: Warp is a next-generation terminal emulator designed to modernize the command-line experience for developers. It incorporates artificial intelligence to assist with a range of tasks, including generating commands, debugging errors, and providing context-aware suggestions. Key features include collaborative live sessions for remote teamwork and an advanced, searchable command history. This innovative approach aims to make complex terminal operations more approachable and efficient for users of all skill levels. Warp offers a robust free tier for individual users and provides subscription-based plans for teams that unlock additional collaborative and administrative functionalities.

item.title: Superlists
item.description: Superlists is a simple yet powerful application designed for managing and sharing to-do lists collaboratively. It allows users to create, organize, and share lists of tasks with others, making it ideal for coordinating group projects, family chores, or shared shopping lists. The app focuses on a clean, intuitive interface and real-time syncing to ensure everyone involved is always up-to-date. Superlists offers a freemium model, with basic functionality available for free and premium features for enhanced collaboration and organization.

item.title: rust-analyzer
item.description: rust-analyzer is a language server that provides rich IDE features for the Rust programming language. It works by integrating with text editors and IDEs that support the Language Server Protocol (LSP) to offer intelligent code completion, diagnostics, refactoring, and code navigation. It's a free and open-source project developed by the Rust community, offering a powerful and efficient way to develop in Rust. Pricing is non-applicable as it's a community-driven tool.

item.title: Unpoly
item.description: Unpoly is a JavaScript framework designed to make dynamic web applications feel faster and more responsive without the complexity of modern SPA frameworks. It works by enhancing HTML with special attributes, allowing for partial page updates, instant navigation, and form submissions that don't require a full page reload. It's built by the creators of the HTML5 Canvas Game Framework and is focused on developer productivity and a fluid user experience.

item.title: CREEM 2.0
item.description: CREEM 2.0 is a comprehensive platform designed to empower creators and developers to sell their AI-generated software and digital products globally. It streamlines the entire business process, handling everything from payment processing and tax compliance to payouts and affiliate management. The tool offers integrated usage-based billing, allowing creators to monetize their AI products effectively based on consumption. It's a robust financial infrastructure built specifically for the burgeoning AI economy.

item.title: Ground Stop Watch
item.description: This tool provides a live and replayable map of U.S. flights during FAA nationwide ground stops. It visualizes aircraft in the air relative to normal operations, allowing users to see the immediate impact of such events. Built by grounds.top, it's designed to offer transparency during air traffic disruptions. For instance, during an FAA ground stop, you could monitor how many flights are still attempting to depart or are airborne versus typical traffic patterns.

item.title: Arktype
item.description: Arktype is a comprehensive starter kit for building design systems, offering pre-built components, foundational styles, and a structured approach to maintain consistency across digital products. It's designed to accelerate the creation of robust and scalable design systems for teams of any size. The tool provides a solid foundation that can be customized to fit specific brand guidelines and project needs, operating on a freemium model with generous core offerings. Arktype excels at providing a well-organized structure for design tokens and component documentation.

item.title: Explain Shell
item.description: Explain Shell is a web-based tool that demystifies complex command-line arguments for various Unix-like systems. Users paste a command, and the tool breaks down each option and argument, explaining its purpose and how it affects the command's execution. It leverages a comprehensive database of common commands and their options, providing context and definitions that would otherwise require extensive manual research or man page diving. It's built and maintained by the community, ensuring its utility across a wide range of command-line tools.

item.title: jev-ultrafast
item.description: jev-ultrafast is a Python script designed for extreme speed in data processing tasks. Its core promise is to deliver unparalleled performance, likely through highly optimized algorithms and efficient use of system resources. While the exact nature of the data processing isn't detailed, its significant popularity on GitHub suggests it addresses a common need for faster execution in data-intensive applications. It operates as a standalone script, implying it's intended for developers looking to accelerate specific processing bottlenecks.

item.title: agweb
item.description: Agweb is a lightweight, macOS-native browser designed specifically for developers working with multiple AI coding agents. It utilizes WebKit, the same engine as Safari, to provide a stable and unobtrusive browsing experience. Unlike standard browser windows that can steal focus or become resource-heavy, agweb allows agents to control tabs programmatically via a command-line interface. This means you can watch your agents work in real-time without interruption, and idle tabs are efficiently suspended to minimize CPU and memory usage. It's built by a developer for developers who need to manage a fleet of AI assistants.

item.title: Inkscape
item.description: Inkscape is a free and open-source vector graphics editor for GNU/Linux, Windows, and macOS. It is the premier free and open-source SVG (Scalable Vector Graphics) editor, with sophisticated capabilities. Its primary function is to create and edit vector graphics, making it ideal for illustrations, logos, icons, diagrams, and any design that needs to scale without losing quality. Inkscape supports advanced features like gradient meshes, path effects, and object grouping, offering a professional-grade alternative to proprietary software.

item.title: Yogurt
item.description: Yogurt is a free, open-source application designed to provide private AI-driven meeting summaries. It records your calls without requiring a bot to join the meeting, addressing privacy concerns often associated with such tools. The output includes concise summaries of discussions, identification of next steps with assigned individuals, and personal reminders. It's positioned as a more privacy-conscious and cost-effective alternative to services like Granola.

item.title: FontForge
item.description: FontForge is a powerful, free, and open-source font editor designed for comprehensive font creation and modification. It natively supports a wide array of essential desktop font formats, including TrueType, OpenType, and PostScript, enabling seamless workflow across different platforms and applications. Users can draw entirely new glyphs from scratch, meticulously refine existing letterforms, and effortlessly convert fonts between various formats. The software provides granular control over typographic elements such as glyph outlines, spacing, kerning pairs, font hinting for improved rendering, and the management of extensive font metadata. It is an indispensable tool for professional type designers, graphic designers, and anyone requiring precise and detailed manipulation of typographic assets.

item.title: ZigZag
item.description: ZigZag is a visual embroidery editor built with Rust, designed for high performance and to integrate with AI agents via its Model Context Protocol. It allows users to transform SVG artwork into embroidery stitches, offering fine-tuning capabilities within the editor. Designs can be exported in common formats like PES, DST, EXP, JEF, or VP3 for compatibility with most embroidery machines, or sent directly to compatible Brother machines via Bluetooth. This tool empowers both traditional designers and those leveraging AI for creative output.

item.title: HowToLiveBetter
item.description: HowToLiveBetter offers a scientifically grounded and economically efficient approach to personal improvement. This resource synthesizes actionable strategies across diverse life domains, including extending lifespan, preventing illness, optimizing financial planning, navigating legal considerations, and making informed decisions about family. Each presented recommendation is meticulously supported by a cost-benefit analysis, a transparent evidence grading system, and direct citations to original academic research or authoritative public documents. This ensures that users receive not only reliable guidance but also the underlying data for verification and deeper understanding.

item.title: Term Sheet, Please
item.description: Term Sheet, Please is a compelling web-based simulation game that immerses players in the high-stakes world of early-stage startup investment, specifically mirroring the Y Combinator accelerator program. Drawing inspiration from the acclaimed game 'Papers, Please,' this title challenges users to act as venture capitalists, meticulously sifting through an array of simulated startup pitches. Each pitch comes with a dossier of documents, including fact sheets, investor notes, and market research. Players must critically analyze this information, applying their judgment to decide which ventures warrant funding and which to pass on, effectively managing their investment portfolio under a simulated time constraint and pressure.
